channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: The day's curated vulnerabilities highlight a severe concentration of web-based attacks, primarily targeting the WordPress ecosystem with widespread remote code execution, file upload, and authentication bypass flaws across multiple plugins. Critical infrastructure and IoT sectors face distinct dangers, including unauthenticated remote code execution in openPDC power grid monitors and TOZED network printers, as well as a fundamental entropy flaw in NXP microcontrollers that compromises cryptographic integrity. Additional high-impact findings include an AWS Bedrock agent core vulnerability enabling unauthorized tool invocation, command injection risks affecting GNU Emacs development environments, and a remote exploit for OpenSpug server management tools that poses immediate takeover potential.

item.title: CVE-2026-108976 — Desktop OS
item.description: GNU Emacs command injection via filenames allows local attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands, compromising developer workstations and automated build environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-79992 — Desktop OS
item.description: Improper sanitization of login arguments in the TRAMP module enables local privilege escalation and remote code execution through crafted file paths.

item.title: CVE-2026-108544 — Mobile Security
item.description: Path traversal in the Android-based Lippu Docx Reader app allows remote attackers to access restricted file paths, potentially exposing sensitive device data and violating user privacy.

item.title: CVE-2026-19736 — IoT Security
item.description: Flawed entropy handling in the NXP MCUX TRNG driver compromises cryptographic randomness on i.MX RT series microcontrollers, undermining foundational device security mechanisms.

item.title: CVE-2026-18830 — Cloud Security
item.description: Insufficient input validation in AWS Bedrock AgentCore allows authenticated users to bypass model invocation controls and execute unauthorized tools within cloud AI workflows.

item.title: CVE-2026-108540 — Cloud Security
item.description: Remote OS command injection in OpenSpug Spug's file transfer module enables complete server takeover; the publication of a working exploit significantly increases real-world exploitation risk.

item.title: CVE-2026-108576 — Network Devices
item.description: Critical OS command injection in the TOZED X300 IPPingDiagnostics handler permits unauthenticated remote attackers to fully compromise network-connected printing infrastructure.

item.title: CVE-2026-100730 — Industrial Control
item.description: Unauthenticated deserialization of client-supplied data structures in openPDC enables remote code execution on critical power grid monitoring systems lacking Windows Authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-103889 — Web Security
item.description: Missing authentication and nonce checks combined with unsanitized input in a WooCommerce plugin allow unauthenticated remote code execution on compromised WordPress sites.

item.title: CVE-2026-94589 — Web Security
item.description: Arbitrary file upload vulnerability in a Contact Form 7 extension plugin bypasses MIME and extension validation, enabling attackers to deploy persistent web shells.

item.title: CVE-2026-104732 — Web Security
item.description: Authentication bypass in the Advanced IP Blocker plugin occurs due to missing server-side step verification, allowing unauthenticated actors to circumvent security restrictions.

item.title: CVE-2026-42696 — Web Security
item.description: Presents an unauthenticated Remote Code Execution flaw in the SiteVault backup plugin, enabling immediate full server compromise without any credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-62024 — Web Security
item.description: Allows unauthenticated arbitrary file uploads in the CodeBard Help Desk plugin, facilitating persistent web shell deployment and backend takeover.

item.title: CVE-2026-62031 — Web Security
item.description: Features an unauthenticated blind SQL injection in the uListing directory plugin, granting attackers direct access to extract sensitive database records.

item.title: CVE-2026-42716 — Web Security
item.description: Exposes an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in the Payever WooCommerce gateway, leading to remote code execution via insecure deserialization.

item.title: CVE-2026-42718 — Web Security
item.description: Contains an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the Booster for WooCommerce plugin, allowing attackers to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2026-42704 — Web Security
item.description: Unauthenticated local file inclusion in the Kids Care theme enables reading sensitive server configuration files and potentially chaining to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-106608 — Web Security
item.description: Triggers incorrect privilege assignment in the core WooCommerce plugin, affecting millions of global e-commerce sites by allowing unauthorized role escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-39801 — Web Security
item.description: Grants subscriber-level privilege escalation in the AIWU plugin, compromising WordPress installation integrity by elevating low-privileged user accounts to administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-81797 — Web Security
item.description: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in a widely deployed WordPress theme allows attackers to execute arbitrary code without credentials, posing a severe threat to site integrity and data confidentiality.

item.title: CVE-2026-62032 — Web Security
item.description: Critical Local File Inclusion flaw in DirectoryPress enables unauthenticated actors to read sensitive server files, which can lead to credential theft or full system compromise.

item.title: CVE-2026-108707 — Web Security
item.description: Authentication bypass in Wukong_HRM allows unauthenticated users to invoke all HRM APIs, directly exposing highly sensitive employee financial records and personal identifiable information.

item.title: CVE-2026-108708 — Web Security
item.description: Missing authorization checks in Wukong_HRM enable low-privileged employees to escalate privileges and read confidential payroll and banking data across the entire organization.

item.title: CVE-2026-108571 — Web Security
item.description: SQL injection in Xinhu Rainrock RockOA's Openkqj component allows attackers to manipulate database queries, risking unauthorized data extraction, modification, or administrative control.

item.title: CVE-2026-108522 — Web Security
item.description: Improper authentication via X-Forwarded-For header manipulation in Sencho's login endpoint allows attackers to bypass security controls and gain unauthorized access to protected resources.

item.title: CVE-2026-108963 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Authenticated users can manipulate database names passed to system backup commands, resulting in remote code execution on database management servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-108693 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Uncontrolled search path vulnerability in ImageMagick on Windows allows attackers to plant malicious executables in working directories, leading to unintended code execution during routine image processing tasks.

item.title: CVE-2026-89630 — Other
item.description: Regression in the Linux SMB client's oplock break validation removes critical data offset bounds checking, potentially causing memory corruption or unexpected protocol parsing failures.

item.title: CVE-2026-108539 — Other
item.description: Use-after-free flaw in GPAC's MP4Box component can be triggered remotely via crafted media files, potentially causing application crashes or arbitrary code execution in affected media processing environments.
